product_family: Apple Health: built-in health and fitness tracking across iOS, watchOS, macOS, iPadOS, and Vision Pro. Includes Heart Rate, Sleep, Activity Rings, Cycle Tracking, Mental Health, Hearing Health (with AirPods Pro), Health Records (sharing with healthcare providers), and Research app. AI features: on-device processing; no cloud AI training on personal health data.

certifications.name: ISO 27001 (Information Security Management)
certifications.proof_quote: Apple maintains certifications in compliance with the ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27018 standards

certifications.name: ISO 27018 (Privacy in Cloud Services)
certifications.proof_quote: Apple maintains certifications in compliance with the ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27018 standards

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1 or 2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of SOC 2 certification for Apple Health or Apple's cloud services on apple.com domains

certifications.name: HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act)
certifications.proof_quote: Apple does NOT sign Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) for iCloud or the Health app itself. Health Records feature supports HIPAA-compliant storage only when organizations participate in Health Records Directory and sign the Health app data Share with Provider HIPAA BAA, but this is limited to data shared with participating healthcare organizations, not general Health app use.

certifications.name: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation)
certifications.proof_quote: Apple requires its employees who have access to Apple customer data and personal information to undergo an additional Privacy and Security Training course on a biannual basis or in response to updated laws such as the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).

certifications.name: FedRAMP (Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP certification for Apple Health services

certifications.name: PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification; Apple Health does not process payment card data

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Management Systems)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 42001 certification for Apple Health

privacy.ai_training_note: Apple explicitly states: 'Apple does not use our users' private personal data or user interactions when training our foundation models.' Health data is excluded from AI training. Apple uses publicly available data, licensed datasets, open-source data, and synthetic data for model training.
privacy.data_region: Varies by user and iCloud settings. Primary: US. With Advanced Data Protection (2FA), users can enable end-to-end encryption via iCloud; health records shared with healthcare providers are stored in HIPAA-compliant systems.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: TLS/HTTPS; health data encrypted while syncing to iCloud and in transit to healthcare providers

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: Device-level: AES with passcode/Touch ID/Face ID. iCloud: encrypted at rest. End-to-end encryption available with 2FA enabled.

security.name: On-Device Processing
security.value: Medications, Mental Health assessments, and Siri Health requests processed on-device; trends and cycle predictions computed locally without server transmission

security.name: Access Control
security.value: Health data on device accessible only with user authentication (passcode, biometric). Apple cannot access encryption keys for healthcare provider data. Two-factor authentication prevents Apple from decrypting synced data.

security.name: Data Minimization
security.value: Apple minimizes collection; data stays on device by default. Only data explicitly shared by user or synced to iCloud is transmitted.

security.name: Healthcare Organization Data Handling
security.value: Health Records data from healthcare providers is downloaded directly to device over encrypted connection; does not traverse Apple servers. Apple cannot access or decrypt this data.

products.name: Health App (Core)
products.data_scope: Activity, heart rate, sleep, menstrual cycle, mental health, medications, body measurements, workouts, ECG, blood oxygen, temperature
products.notes: Available on iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, Vision Pro. On-device encrypted; optional iCloud sync. NOT HIPAA BAA compliant for healthcare use.

products.name: Health Records
products.data_scope: EHR data from participating healthcare organizations (medical records, diagnoses, medications, allergies, lab results)
products.notes: Limited feature requiring participating healthcare organization. HIPAA BAA signed between Apple and organization. Data encrypted end-to-end. Not available in all regions.

products.name: Health Sharing
products.data_scope: User-selected health metrics shared with family/friends via encrypted connections
products.notes: End-to-end encrypted peer-to-peer sharing. User controls what is shared.

products.name: Apple Research App
products.data_scope: Voluntary health data contributions to clinical research studies
products.notes: Users opt-in to share data for research. Data stored securely per HIPAA requirements for research.

products.name: Fitness+ Meditations & Mental Health
products.data_scope: Meditation sessions, mood tracking, mental health assessments (clinically validated questionnaires)
products.notes: On-device processing where possible. Optional cloud sync.

products.name: Hearing Health (AirPods Pro)
products.data_scope: Hearing test results, hearing aid settings, noise exposure
products.notes: Clinical-grade hearing test. Data synced to Health app with end-to-end encryption if 2FA enabled.

compare.pricing_model: Free (included with Apple device purchase). Fitness+ subscriptions optional ($10.99/month or bundled with Apple One).
compare.data_residency: Primarily US (iCloud default). User can enable Advanced Data Protection for end-to-end encryption and additional privacy control.
top_certs: HIPAA (Limited: Health Records feature only, not general app)

flags: Apple Health does not include a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement, so healthcare organizations cannot lawfully use iCloud or standard Health app sync for PHI storage. The Health Records feature has limited BAA coverage only for data shared with participating organizations.
iCloud health data without Advanced Data Protection (2FA) is NOT HIPAA compliant due to Apple's inability to execute BAAs.
Health Records feature adoption requires healthcare organization to join Apple's program and sign separate HIPAA BAA; not a default feature.
No SOC 2 certification found for Apple Health or iCloud services: significant gap for healthcare and regulated-industry use.
Concerns about Apple's historical auto-opt-in defaults for AI features (though health data itself is excluded from training).

Data residency for international users not clearly documented; default US-based iCloud may not meet EU data residency requirements unless Advanced Data Protection (end-to-end encryption) is explicitly enabled.
